title: 밸류 정의 스펙트럼 확장 × B2 tier-조건부 (밸류 아크 완결 라운드)
objective: EBIT/EV 계열(V14/V07) 밖 밸류 정의도 같은 벽(2024+ recency 감쇠 + incumbent 잉여)인지 전수 확인해 '밸류 추가 방향' 완결 답. screening-tier only, NOT dossier.
honest_prior: 낮음(정직). KR value standalone 24/24 post-2015 감쇠(EP/BM 등급 F, reference-kr-value-factor-decay). R30/FQ-046이 EBIT/EV로 신호 진짜·2024+ 역전·incumbent corr 0.98 잉여 확정. 스펙트럼 완결성만.

value_subaxes.coverage: SPARSE (~222-615 KR-wide) — dividend/buyback payers only; non-mega tilt weakened where missing (v_z=0). honest label.

value_subaxes.note: reuse WT_005 value_panels.parquet vz_off0 for parity with R30 B2

construction.form: B2 (non-mega tier-conditional value tilt) verbatim from R30 r30_measure.R add_cond_blend
construction.detail: b_z=zc(base per month); v_z=zc(value_subaxis per month, 0 if missing); v_boost=v_z if tier in {MID,OTHER} else 0; csc=0.7*b_z+0.3*v_boost; cap-w top-25 from csc via weighted_screen_bt (15bps, liq 2e8, K200uKQ150)
construction.tier: SIZE monthly desc: MEGA 1-10 / MID 11-30 / OTHER 31+
construction.value_vintage: off0 = T-1 clean (factor_db month M = AS_OF-1), aligned z via align_factor_direction (C13). identical vintage to R29/R30.

metrics_per_subaxis.authority: cap-w top-25 paired NW-t (lag3) vs clean base (screening, metric_type=weighted_screen)
fields: cor_active(variant vs base = incumbent-redundancy screening proxy)
metrics_per_subaxis.recency_key_axis: paired_post2024 vs paired_pre2024 — does any definition suffer LESS 2024+ reversal (FQ-046 EBIT/EV pre +3.96 -> post -1.67)
metrics_per_subaxis.dual_basis: EW-uni PORT_t + oos_retention_approx via canonical_screen_bt diag (non-binding, cap-w authoritative)

subaxis_redundancy_check: pairwise cross-sectional corr of value sub-axis z (concern #1 — high corr => effectively fewer independent trials)

gates.note: screening only — graduation HARD (PORT_t 2.95 forge / oos 0.7 / calmar 0.64) NOT evaluated here

verdict_branches.arc_complete: ALL sub-axes 2024+ reversal (paired_post2024 <= 0 or << pre) AND cor_active high => 밸류 정의축 config-scoped 소진 (아크 완결 L-code)
verdict_branches.frontier_open: any sub-axis paired_post2024 not decayed AND cor_active < 0.5 => that one -> next-round dossier candidate (frontier, NOT this round)

selection_type: chain (each sub-axis independent value definition, hypothesis-driven; NOT sweep argmax). DSR computed as diagnostic (n_trials family = 7 sub-axes + value family cumulative ~8 from R26-R30). low-EV round multiple-testing acknowledged in challenge_note.
prohibitions: 02:00 insider crawl + R9 auto-fire UNTOUCHED (R31 writes only stage_artifacts)
no covariance / no weights / no pre-optimization (alpha-research role boundary)
canonical/clean base only; pin recorded; OneDrive temp+rename I/O
pin: R28_current_20260714 (RAWDATA/factor_db snapshot as used by WT_004/005/006)
self_adversarial_concerns_preregistered: #1 sub-axis high mutual corr => effectively 1 test (redundant trials) — measured via subaxis_redundancy_check
#2 factor DB value definitions PIT integrity (financial-statement lag C4) — factor_db aligned-z is PIT-built; off0 = T-1 vintage (clean) verified by R29 parity
#3 low-EV round multiple testing — chain justification (each independent definition, hypothesis-driven, not argmax); DSR diagnostic + value family cumulative trial count disclosed
